# Decision log

Every modelling, scope or process decision, dated, with its reason and the evidence it rests on.
Newest last. A decision is never edited after the fact; a reversal is a new entry that cites the old one.

| # | Date | Decision | Reason / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-01 | pre-2026-09-20 | Trade process is declared, not estimated: win probability pinned by R, p = (1+e)/(1+R); e = 0 is the object of study | Removes trading skill from the experiment; every profile compared at equal expected P&L per trade |
| D-02 | pre-2026-09-20 | Analytic bounds (P(pass) ≤ 2/5, E[gross] ≤ $2,000) derived before simulation and wired in as oracles | A result outside a bound is an engine error, never a finding |
| D-03 | pre-2026-09-20 | Contract machine validated on scripted golden paths before any Monte Carlo | Prevents a transition bug being read as structural edge |
| D-04 | pre-2026-09-20 | Floor convention = **truncate** (contract rule); resize kept as a solver option; "none" (gate-1.8 run model) rejected | "none" gives 4/9 > 2/5 for 1:1 $1,500 — violates the ceiling. results_floor_mode_504.csv |
| D-05 | pre-2026-09-20 | Truncation delivered to the project's engine as a parameter-free MAE law, not an analytic patch | Rules engine must stay deterministic; generator must not see the balance |
| D-06 | pre-2026-09-20 | Edge convention = constant drift per unit variance (θ solved at the trade's own stop/target); fixed before non-zero-edge cells were run | Pre-registration. Later shown not to matter: 26/30 cells identical, max Δ $8 (results_edge_convention.csv) |
| D-07 | 2026-09-20 | Rules re-verified against official help-centre pages; added Combine MLL lock at $0, net-positive-since-payout rule, optional $30 payout fee; all experiments rerun | Official 8284197/8284204/8284208/8284233. See D-16 on attribution of the net-positive rule |
| D-08 | 2026-09-20 | Combine profile: static 1:1, $1,500, one trade/day | P(pass) = 16/49 exact; resolves fastest; no tested state policy beats it |
| D-09 | 2026-09-20 | Funded profile: day-one all-in on the full cushion at highest executable R, then harvest | Leak identity E[Q] = (1 − P_pay)(2000 − E[ratchet]); net = 0.9·2000·R/(1+R) |
